purpose: Year-end recap; teach 取締役/幹部/当社/既存/民営/法的/解析/自立

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今年も、取締役会を無事に乗り切ったな。
lines.en: We made it through this year’s board too.
lines.style: relieved boss reflecting, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 幹部の協力なしには、難しかったです。
lines.en: Without executive cooperation, it’d have been hard.
lines.style: manager crediting peers, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員一同に感謝だ。
lines.en: I’m grateful to all our company’s staff.
lines.style: warm boss thanking, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 既存の顧客との関係も、深まりました。
lines.en: Relationships with existing customers deepened too.
lines.style: manager noting progress, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の民営化の動きにも、対応できた。
lines.en: We adapted to the industry’s privatization moves too.
lines.style: boss appraising, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 法的な観点でも、問題はありません。
lines.en: No issues from a legal viewpoint either.
lines.style: manager confirming, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 解析チームが、本当に頑張ってくれた。
lines.en: The analytics team really pulled through.
lines.style: boss praising the team, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 来年も、自立した経営を続けましょう。
lines.en: Next year too, let’s continue independent management.
lines.style: manager closing forward-looking, voice clear and distinctly their own
